title: The Soledad theme for WordPress is vulnerable to unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in versions up to, and…
description: The Soledad WordPress theme versions up to and including 8.7.7 contain a vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote code execution. This occurs due to improper validation in the penci_more_post_ajax AJAX action, which processes base64 and URL-decoded input through a shortcode function that fails to properly inspect nested Elementor elements. This leads to the rendering of attacker-controlled content. Additionally, a path traversal local file inclusion is possible via the unsanitized 'style' setting in the penci-featured-sliders widget, which includes PHP files based on user input.
